title: High throughput RNA sequencing of a hybrid maize and its parents shows different mechanisms responsive to nitrogen limitation
genotypes: SRG100 (elite inbred, lower NUE); SRG200 (elite inbred, higher NUE); SRG150 (hybrid of SRG100 and SRG200, cross direction NR); Syngenta lines
stage_age: harvested 4 weeks after transfer to hydroponics (seeds germinated 2 d in Turface)
growth_system: hydroponic (25 L nutrient solution per container); growth cabinet (Conviron), 16 h light ~500 umol m-2 s-1 at 28 °C / 8 h dark at 23 °C
N_treatments: sufficient N 3 mM KNO3 vs limiting N 1 mM KNO3
other_factors: genotype (2 inbreds + hybrid); tissue (leaf vs root)
timepoints_duration: N treatment throughout ~4 weeks of hydroponic growth; single harvest at noon
bio_reps: 1 library per genotype x N x tissue (each pooled from 2-3 plants); no biological replicates
platform_layout: Illumina Genome Analyzer II, PE36 or PE40 (one lane per library)
other_omics: none (qRT-PCR validation; physiology reported in authors' earlier study)
key_finding: Genotype-specific N-limitation responses; hybrid expression resembles higher-NUE parent SRG200; allele-specific expression detected in hybrid
notes: Pooled samples, no biological replicates; reads mapped to B73 AGPv2 (TopHat/Cufflinks); growth system identical to authors' earlier hydroponic NUE study

title: Root Type-Specific Reprogramming of Maize Pericycle Transcriptomes by Local High Nitrate Results in Disparate Lateral Root Branching Patterns
tissue: phloem-pole pericycle cells (laser capture microdissection, ~2,000 cells per sample) from root segments 3-5 mm from the tip of primary, seminal, crown and brace roots
stage_age: roots treated at ~7 cm length (seedlings moved to nutrient solution 7 d after germination); brace roots after brace-root initiation; exact age at LCM sampling NR (anatomy: 7-d primary, 9-d seminal, 15-d crown, 60-d brace roots)
growth_system: paper rolls then hydroponic nutrient solution; two-compartment split-root system (primary, seminal, crown roots); two neighbouring brace roots enclosed in a small plastic bag with solution (plants grown in 20-L containers); growth chamber 16 h light 25 °C / 8 h dark 21 °C
N_treatments: homogeneous low nitrate 0.5 mM NO3- (control) vs local high nitrate 4 mM NO3- (N salt NR)
timepoints_duration: 24 h local nitrate treatment before LCM sampling (morphology assessed after 20 d of treatment)
bio_reps: 3 per root type x N condition
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000, PE100 (~23 M 100-bp paired-end reads per sample; 24 libraries on 4 lanes)
key_finding: Local high nitrate triggers root type-specific pericycle reprogramming; brace roots show strongest transcriptomic and architectural plasticity
source_of_details: abstract + PMC article web page (WebFetch); PMC API returned no text
notes: Cell type-specific (LCM) RNA-seq; N salt/counter-ion not stated in fetched text; control arrangement for brace roots not detailed in fetched text

title: ZmNRT1.1B (ZmNPF6.6) determines nitrogen use efficiency via regulation of nitrate transport and signalling in maize
genotypes: WT ND101; zmnrt1.1b CRISPR/Cas9 loss-of-function mutant; zmnlp3.1 CRISPR/Cas9 loss-of-function mutant (both in ND101 background; allele names not legible in PMC text)
stage_age: seedlings after 10-d hydroponic pre-culture (transferred 6 d after germination) plus 4-d N starvation; age at sampling NR
growth_system: hydroponic; climate chamber 14 h light 28 °C / 10 h dark 22 °C, 300 umol m-2 s-1, 60% RH
N_treatments: pre-culture 1 mM (NH4)2SO4 + 2 mM KNO3; then N-free solution for 4 d; then 5 mM KNO3 vs 5 mM KCl (control) for 2 h
timepoints_duration: 4-d N starvation then 2-h nitrate (or KCl) treatment; single time point
n_libraries: NR (3 genotypes x 2 treatments; replicates NR)
repository: NCBI GEO (deposition stated; ID not legible)
other_omics: physiology (15N nitrate uptake; biomass; N content); qPCR; ZmNLP3.1-eGFP localization; field yield trials at 0/120 and 0/158/225 kg N/ha (no RNA-seq)
key_finding: ZmNRT1.1B drives high-affinity nitrate uptake and signalling via ZmNLP3.1 nuclear shuttling; overexpression raises low-N field yield
notes: GEO ID hyperlink stripped from PMC text and PMC web page fetch blocked (CAPTCHA), so accession not found; 891 nitrate-induced and 840 nitrate-repressed genes in WT roots; mapped to B73 RefGen_v4 (HISAT2/DESeq2); Epub 2023-10-02; CAU mutant stock IDs CAUC0713/CAUC0714/CAUC1783 are germplasm, not sequence data
